newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Bahrain's first frigate arrives from the U.S..
newsitem.headline: Bahrain's first frigate arrives from the U.S..

text.p: Bahrain's first frigate arrived in the island on Wednesday after a two-month journey from the United States, the official Gulf News Agency reported.
Sabha, a former U.S. navy frigate which was donated to Bahrain, started its journey from the port of Charleston, S.C., in the United States in May.
U.S. officials have said the former Jack Williams, worth around $56 million, was donated to the Gulf Arab state in appreciation for Manama's close friendship with Washington.
They said the Arab state paid around $35 million for new equipment for the frigate and the training of its crew in the United States.
Bahrain, which has a defence cooperation agreement with the United States, is the administrative headquarters for the U.S. Navy's Fifth Fleet. Washington keeps about 20 warships in the Gulf.
